{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline and biomarker_final
# The data dictionary mentions -999.0 as a sentinel for missing
sentinel_count_baseline = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0).sum()
sentinel_count_final = (df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0).sum()

# Check if any other values are implausible (e.g., negative biomarker_final)
# But we are told -999.0 is sentinel, so negative values might be valid
# We'll check the distribution
biomarker_baseline_desc = df['biomarker_baseline'].describe()
biomarker_final_desc = df['biomarker_final'].describe()

# Check for negative biomarker_final
negative_final = (df['biomarker_final'] < 0).sum()

# Return all
print(sentinel_count_baseline)
print(sentinel_count_final)
print(biomarker_baseline_desc)
print(biomarker_final_desc)
print(negative_final)"}
